corpus.name: Maskera privacy-safe Swedish domain regression corpus

method.input: Two ordered JSONL-as-text chunks below LogosGuard's 50,000-character file limit
method.scoring: A full hit removes every Unicode letter or digit from the annotated value; retaining some is a partial leak and retaining all is a clear-text miss.
method.encoding: LogosGuard 2.4.4 returned UTF-8 input as reversible Windows-1252 mojibake; output text was restored to Unicode before scoring.
method.exclusions: JSONL id and category metadata are excluded because LogosGuard also redacted digits inside record IDs.
method.precision: The corpus is not exhaustively annotated for every defensible name, place or organisation, so this run does not report precision.
